_meta.label: Objection Strategy
_meta.instruction: Start from the audience objection or skepticism. Acknowledge it without exaggeration. Respond using relevant verified product truths. Do not guarantee that the product solves the objection for everyone. Do not attack other products or methods.

too_hard.label: Too Hard
too_hard.definition: The persona believes the plan will take too much effort. Answer with supported ease, time fit, or homemade-food compatibility.

too_confusing.label: Too Confusing
too_confusing.definition: The persona does not know what to follow. Answer with structure, day-wise guidance, or coach support.

tried_before.label: Tried Before
tried_before.definition: The persona has failed other methods. Acknowledge that history. Position this as a guided course, not another loose product.

too_much_hunger.label: Too Much Hunger
too_much_hunger.definition: Hunger or cravings broke previous plans. Use only supplied hunger-support truths.

no_support.label: No Support
no_support.definition: The persona felt alone on previous plans. Use supplied coach, tracker, or guidance truths.

too_time_consuming.label: Too Time Consuming
too_time_consuming.definition: The persona cannot add a large routine. Use supplied time or simplicity claims only.

skeptical_of_products.label: Skeptical Of Products
skeptical_of_products.definition: The persona doubts products in this category. Use supplied authority, structure, or money-back policy. Do not overclaim.
